# Wario Land 3 Archipelago

> **AI Disclaimer**
> A significant portion of this project was built with the assistance of Claude Code. I want to be fully transparent about this — as it was also a personal learning project for me. I have no issue with anyone choosing not to use this because of AI involvement, and I appreciate any and all feedback with this project!

---

> HUGE SHOUTOUTS to snackerfork for the awesome AP logo and keyring sprite, @lizzietwoshoes for separating chest/key logic (and logic help in general), and ivory for helping with logic too!

---

## What is this?

A randomizer for **Wario Land 3** built on the [Archipelago](https://archipelago.gg) multiworld framework. All 100 chests are randomized, with the option to also randomize the keys and big (musical) coins with treasures and each other, as well as many other Quality of Life and Cosmetic options as well. All locked levels start with a Red blinking node, and will turn white once they are available to play (when you find their level unlock).

See the list below for various info.

**This project is completely unrelated to the current Wario Land 3 Randomizer. Please direct any questions/concerns to the Archipelago Discord with this project!**

## Documentation

- [Setup](docs/Setup.md) — requirements, first-time setup, getting connected
- [Settings](docs/Settings.md) — full list of YAML options and what they do
- [Logic](docs/Logic.md) — full logic for keys, chests, big coins, transformation and enemizer, for all logic options.
- [FAQ](docs/FAQ.md) — what's changed from vanilla, how to report bugs
- [Known Quirks](docs/Known_Quirks.md) — known visual / logic oddities
- [Big Coin Maps](https://github.com/RvPA-Roopa/Wario-Land-3-Archipelago/blob/main/docs/bigcoins/README.md) — coin location maps for every level (Big Coinsanity)
- [PopTracker Pack](https://github.com/LizzieTwoShoes/WL3-AP-PopTracker-Pack/releases) — tracker pack by @lizzietwoshoes
- [Future Plans](https://trello.com/b/hF0nKXow/wario-land-3-ap) — Trello board

notes.text:
This is a BIG update with A LOT of new features/fixes. This has been tested, but since it's such a big update, there may be (and probably will be) some bugs. It shouldn't be anything gamebreaking, but please let me know if there is. I will label this a pre-release until we've done a bit more testing. This shouldn't be brought to public syncs just yet, but I will add it as stable when it should be. 

## New Features

### Shopsanity 
Adds an entirely new shop to the right of the temple! The options for this include different price tiers: cheap, normal and expensive. Each have weighted prices with 2 at the lower end, 2 towards the top, and 6 in the middle. (There's currently no hard set logic for these checks, as you're able to grind out coins in level as needed). 

### New Victory Condition
Adds the 10 bosses as a potential win condition. There is also a new option of "bosses_required" (similar to music_boxes_required) where you can choose how many bosses you want as your win condition. This CAN be used in conjunction with boss_defeats granting items.

### Hidden blocks and coins
Added a new option under "hidden_blocks_revealed" to ALSO color guaranteed coin blocks differently than normal blocks. This will be useful for grinding out coins... and maybe for something in the future? 👀 

## QoL Updates

### Temple update
- You can now enter the temple before being able to beat Rudy. He will tell you how many bosses/music boxes you have left before you can fight him.

### Pause Menu Treasure Tracker
- Updated the treasure count at the top of the treasure tracker to dynamically show how many locations you've checked (i.e. 10/410). 
- Replaced the page count at the top right with the win condition requirements you've collected so far.
- Added multiple new pages to the treasure tracker menu:
  - Musical Coin tracker
  - Keys, bosses and chests tracker (tracks how many you've collected per level)
  - Transformations treasure page
  - Shows your "Owned Keys" per level, so you can see what keys you have (G R G B = Grey, Red, Green, Blue)

### Misc. 

- Keys are now their vanilla sprites, with a large ACTUALLY readable letter/number for their corresponding level.
- Changed a few palettes for in-game text, as well as increasing the text size to be more uniform.
- Roll/ice skatin' without transformations on now returns them back to their vanilla states (can't turn)
- Pauses are now allowed in boss rooms, so on the off-chance you get soft locked, you can return to the overworld.
- Palette shuffle updates to include more saturation randomization. This helps with the lack of colors to choose from, adds a bit more variety.
- Crests now replaced by coins. 1 Coin = 1 Coin, 2 slimmer coins = 10, 3 sideways coins = 25 and 4 sideways coins = 50. 
- Made some yaml changes for conciseness

### Bug Fixes
- Scowler blocks finally fixed. 
- Gold magic spawning waves in N1 fixed.
- Glass Eyes door, Golden eyes door and fence all adjusted in Tower of Revival to look as they should if you do not own their items.
- Vast Plains finally don't have empty space when you have chemicals but no magic seeds. Coin 6 still needs chemicals or magic seeds to spawn.
- Cave of Flames now actually shows rusted blocks correctly, regardless of variant.
- Removed a few dust/particles that were still being overwritten by lettering.
- Overworld crash now gated so you can't spam right or left in the transition. Should no longer crash
- Large blocks are now breakable from above without Garlic. 
- You should no longer get spammed with item popups after re-connecting.
- Probably so much more that I'm forgetting

### Lizzie's Logic Fixes

- Out of the Woods Coin 3 now requires Puffy Form
- Added flying past the climbable fencing back to Tower of Revival
- Added rolling past currents into easy glitches logic
- Added using the blue key/chest door to get past the warps without warp removal apparatus into knowledge check logic
- Added getting Castle of Illusions coins 2 and 3 via wall jump to all glitches logic
